lexicalDecisions.disposition: Proposed necessary primary-reading support: 凝るこる, 凝らすこらす, 凝固ぎょうこ. All senses retained in raw packet; selected teaching and limits in progress reading/support records.

Verified exact homograph/recognition examples for all three unselectedこご readings. Not source-only, not invalid/automatically archaic; 凝るこごる explicitly usually kana. Do not cross-link primaryこる/こらす articles as though they teach these readings.

Construction/morphology evidence: elaborate凝った, shoulder stiffness and conventional を凝らす objects. Retain complete secondary senses, especially 肩が凝る's figurative unease and 息を凝らす's holding breath; do not mechanically translate every object as staring or every shoulder expression as literal muscles. No separate support article proposed.
凝と/凝乎と and 凝視める/見凝める are search-only index spellings. Do not teach ordinaryじっと/みつめる as additional source kanji readings or create articles on these spellings.
混凝土 is marked rare ateji and the word usually kana. Concrete is not evidence that 凝 supplies some arbitrary substring ofコンクリート. Not selected.

Separate nominal/verb families: 凝り/凝 hasこり versusしこり restrictions, 凝る/痼る hasしこる, and 凝りこごり is usually kana. These do not replace the complete frozen character-reading list or become extra practice keys. Respectしこり-only medical/uneasiness senses.

Every other exact凝 family is retained and read but not selected for this bounded introductory support. These include congealing/collecting compounds, medical/physics/chemistry derivatives, historical names, elaborate proverbs and narrow game expressions. Exclusion is a scoped teaching choice, not a blanket rarity, invalidity or absence claim; generated entryIds appended by the audited helper.
